newsitem.title: FINLAND: Norvestia says may match Moyne's Amer bid.
newsitem.headline: Norvestia says may match Moyne's Amer bid.

text.p: Finnish Norvestia said on Thursday its starting point in a possible bid for part of sporting goods group Amer's controlling K-shares would be to offer terms similar to those offered by an earlier bidder.

The investment company said earlier it was interested in becoming a main owner of Amer together with some current K shareholder. British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, third Lord Moyne, said on June 2 that he planned to buy a controlling stake of Amer K shares.
"The starting point for Novestia Oy Ab is that the sellers would receive principally similar conditions as in Lord Moyne's model," Norvestia said in a new statement.
Guinness has offered to buy 1.1 million K shares in Amer for 301 million markka.
